ACCESSIBILITY_REQUIREMENT.description: Obtain and retain the missing accessibility validation evidence before treating this dependency as confirmed.

AUTHORITY_RULE.description: Confirm the named decision authority and retain segregation evidence; do not delegate authority through this assessment.

COMMUNICATION_TEMPLATE.description: Review content, accessibility, support route and restricted-information boundaries before pilot use.

CONTROL.description: Define the control owner, test evidence, failure behavior and monitoring evidence before implementation.

DATA_OBJECT.description: Confirm ownership, access, retention, lineage and migration implications before implementation.

EXTERNAL_SERVICE.description: Close the vendor-capacity evidence gap and verify the service dependency within the authorised pilot boundary.

PROCESS_STEP.description: Update the controlled procedure, responsibility, input/output evidence and acceptance test for this step.

ROLE.description: Confirm responsibility, authority, workload and training impacts with the accountable business owner.

SYSTEM.description: Assess configuration, interface, access, test and rollback implications without executing a system change.

default.description: Confirm the evidence-linked implication with the accountable owner before implementation planning.
